template_params.branch_policy: LOCAL WORKSPACE-ONLY MODE (benchmark sandbox): the task directory is not a git repo and must stay that way. Make NO git changes of any kind: no git init, branch, commit, push, stash or reset. There is no branch to verify: write git-go-ahead.md stating 'no-git local workspace mode' and continue; do NOT abort because git is absent. All later stages likewise make no git changes.
